title: Enrico Fermi's birth chart
metaDescription: Enrico Fermi's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.6° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the nine placements whose signs are settled, cardinal leads with five. Cardinal weight is read as initiative: the instinct to be the reason something began.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 5.6° of Libra is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Venus in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 27.7° Libra, Venus was at 14.3° Scorpio, Mars was at 19.4° Scorpio. Read together: thought that travels by comparison; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins the Sun and Jupiter — a square holding at 1.0°. Nothing in a square flows; everything in it works. The old texts kept squares for the charts they respected. Behind it, Jupiter opposition Neptune at 3.1°, and Mercury trine Neptune at 3.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Jupiter opposes Neptune while both square the Sun. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, five placements stand out. The Sun in Libra at 5.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 14.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Scorpio at 19.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Capricorn at 4.6° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 10.0° is in domicile. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 air, 3 water, 2 earth, 1 fire by element and 5 cardinal, 2 fixed, 2 mutable by modality. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. Pluto was retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.9° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
